severity_levels.blocking: A violation should stop generation, approval, render, validation, or publish for the mapped stage.
severity_levels.must: A required rule whenever the rule set is loaded.
severity_levels.should: A strong default that may be overridden only by safe client/account/style direction.
severity_levels.preference: A default taste or quality preference that should not block by itself.

rule_sets.title: Brand Safety Rules
rule_sets.read_when: Any stage creates facts, story copy, captions, visual plans, or publish-facing copy.

rules.text: Do not invent unsupported facts, quotes, dates, places, claims, metrics, endorsements, outcomes, or source URLs.
Sensitive topics must stay non-graphic, non-exploitative, non-sexualized, and trauma-informed.
Keep current pipeline outputs in English unless multilingual support is explicitly added.

rule_sets.title: Visual Consistency Rules
rule_sets.read_when: Any stage plans visuals, image/video prompts, cover prompts, or render-facing visual metadata.

rules.text: Do not request readable or unreadable generated text, fake writing, random glyphs, subtitles, captions, logos, UI, watermarks, labels, signs, maps, diagrams, charts, documents, plaques, inscriptions, newspapers, or speech bubbles from image/video models. Use blank unmarked surfaces or non-text visual evidence instead.
Every visual prompt needs a concrete subject, action/situation, setting, composition, and story-specific beat.
Preserve continuity for style, recurring subjects, palette, lighting, and camera language.

rule_sets.title: Voice Rules
rule_sets.read_when: Any stage writes narration, dialogue lines, TTS instructions, avatar speech, or voice metadata.

rules.text: Do not change the clean spoken script when adding performance metadata.
Do not drop, reorder, or add narration beats between script, scene lines, and TTS input.
Do not use a real voice or implied endorsement without explicit consent metadata.

rule_sets.title: Music and SFX Rules
rule_sets.read_when: Any stage plans or validates music, SFX, render audio, or licensing.

rules.text: Unknown, unclear, or non-publishable license status must block publish.
Do not request copyrighted tracks, artist soundalikes, or recognizable commercial music unless explicitly licensed.
Narration clarity wins over music/SFX intensity.

rule_sets.title: Avatar Rules
rule_sets.read_when: Any stage evaluates presenter, avatar, likeness, voice, or consent-sensitive generation.

rules.text: Missing, ambiguous, expired, or out-of-scope consent must block avatar generation and publish.
Uploaded character references are creative context, not consent proof.
Avatar generation remains separate from QA, approval, and publish.

rule_sets.title: Editing Rules
rule_sets.read_when: Any stage creates timing, transitions, overlays, render manifest, or Remotion plan.

rules.text: Timelines must be contiguous, positive-duration, and close to target duration.
Captions/subtitles/overlays are renderer metadata, not generated-image text.
Use frame-practical timing for 30fps vertical output.

rule_sets.title: Provider Routing Rules
rule_sets.read_when: Any stage plans providers, adapters, hosting, rendering, or cost-aware routing.

rules.text: If a selected provider is not implemented for a component, fail fast instead of silently using another provider.
Do not expose API keys, tokens, service account material, or secret env values.
Normalize provider outputs to repo contracts before downstream use.

rule_sets.title: Platform Publishing Rules
rule_sets.read_when: Any stage prepares captions, approvals, public URLs, publish rows, or Instagram Graph calls.

rules.text: Publish requires selected-render approval, QA pass, approved_by, approved_at, and matching platform account.
Publishable media URLs must be public HTTPS URLs, not local/private hosts.
Do not publish if existing media IDs or published timestamps indicate prior publication.

rule_sets.title: Approval Rules
rule_sets.read_when: Any stage validates final QA, selected render approval, retry, or publish readiness.

rules.text: Publish must require approval for the exact selected render, not any successful render.
Missing required artifacts, consent, license, caption, render output, or account match must block publish.
Approval records must include selected render, QA status, approval status, approved_by, approved_at, and platform account ID.
